brief: Prioritise Ashford Hill for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure, as outlined in MG-023. Where the unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, in accordance with MG-023. Ensure that every de-rating applied is recorded along with the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified per MG-021.
